primary.title: The Origin and Development of the Quantum Theory
primary.author: Max Planck
primary.rationale: This is Planck's Nobel Prize lecture, offering a direct account of his foundational work on quantum theory.

primary.title: Where is Science Going?
primary.author: Max Planck
primary.rationale: A collection of essays reflecting on the state and future of science by Planck himself, likely to be found in digitized archives.

primary.title: Scientific Autobiography and Other Papers
primary.author: Max Planck
primary.rationale: An autobiographical account of Planck's life and scientific journey, providing personal insights into his work and the era.

secondary.title: Planck: Driven by Vision, Seeking Order
secondary.author: John L. Heilbron
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography of Max Planck by a respected historian of science, published by a major academic press.

secondary.title: Max Planck: The Grandfather of Quantum Physics
secondary.author: Helmut Rechenberg
secondary.rationale: A scholarly biography focusing on Planck's scientific contributions and his role in the development of quantum physics.

secondary.title: Max Planck and the Origins of Quantum Physics
secondary.author: Klaus Hentschel
secondary.rationale: An academic study examining the historical context and intellectual origins of Planck's groundbreaking quantum theory.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are often available as digitized books on Internet Archive. Secondary sources are scholarly biographies and historical analyses of Planck's work.
